defense.description: Multiple-front approach under Thurman; 2026 preview reporting describes 4-2-5 as a base look with three-man fronts also used by personnel (NFL Draft Buzz / related previews). Exclusive single-front doctrine is not rigidly branded on the athletics coaches page.

offense.description: Base run-and-shoot / read-and-attack lineage (Mouse Davis / June Jones tradition via Chang), with Air Raid concepts and RPO wrinkles under Arceneaux; Chang remains primary play-caller with Arceneaux providing booth input (Honolulu Star-Advertiser; Aloha State Daily). Four-wide spacing and quarterback Micah Alejado’s command are central to 2026 previews.
offense.label: run-and-shoot / read-and-attack
